stem: For $\text{CaCO}_3(s)\rightarrow\text{CaO}(s)+\text{CO}_2(g)$ at $300$ K, $\Delta U=+175.00\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$. Find $\Delta H$; take $R=8.314\ \text{J K}^{-1}\text{mol}^{-1}$.
working:
$\Delta H=\Delta U+\Delta n_gRT$; $\Delta n_g=1-0=1$.
$\Delta H=175.00+\dfrac{(1)(8.314)(300)}{1000}=177.4942\approx177.49\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.

Independent check: \(\Delta H=\Delta U+\Delta n_gRT=175.00+(1)(8.314)(300)/1000=177.49\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}\).
solution:
For gaseous species, $\Delta H=\Delta U+\Delta n_gRT$, where $\Delta n_g=1-0=1$.
$$\Delta H=175.00+\frac{(1)(8.314)(300)}{1000}=177.49\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$
